summaries.name: Caprese Salad
summaries.summary: Caprese Salad is a classic Italian salad made with fresh mozzarella, juicy tomatoes, and basil leaves, dressed with olive oil and balsamic glaze.

summaries.name: Thai Basil Chicken
summaries.summary: Thai Basil Chicken is a stir-fry of chicken with Thai basil, chilies, garlic, and lemongrass, served with steamed rice or noodles.

summaries.name: Pesto Pasta
summaries.summary: Pesto Pasta is made by blending basil with garlic, pine nuts, Parmesan, and olive oil into a pesto sauce, tossed with linguine, cherry tomatoes, and grilled chicken.

summaries.name: Basil and Lemon Spaghetti
summaries.summary: Basil and Lemon Spaghetti combines basil, lemon zest, garlic, and olive oil into a light, refreshing spaghetti sauce.

summaries.name: Indian-Style Basil Chutney
summaries.summary: Indian-Style Basil Chutney blends basil with cilantro, green chilies, ginger, and lemon juice into a chutney for naan or rice dishes.

summaries.name: Mint Chutney
summaries.summary: Mint Chutney is similar to basil chutney but with a cooling twist, used as a dip for snacks or a sauce for grilled meats or vegetables.

summaries.name: Minty Fresh Salad
summaries.summary: Minty Fresh Salad combines mint leaves with feta cheese, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and a drizzle of lemon juice and olive oil.

summaries.name: Mint Julep
summaries.summary: Mint Julep is a classic cocktail made with bourbon, mint leaves, sugar, and crushed ice.

summaries.name: Grilled Lamb with Mint Sauce
summaries.summary: Grilled Lamb with Mint Sauce is made by marinating lamb chops in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and mint, then grilling.

summaries.name: Minty Yogurt Sauce
summaries.summary: Minty Yogurt Sauce mixes mint leaves with yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill into a refreshing sauce served with grilled meats or as a dip.

summaries.name: Herby Lemonade
summaries.summary: Herby Lemonade infuses lemonade with fresh basil and mint leaves for a refreshing summer drink.

summaries.name: Middle Eastern-Style Salad
summaries.summary: Middle Eastern-Style Salad combines chopped basil and mint with bulgur, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, feta cheese, and a lemon-tahini dressing.

summaries.name: Basil and Mint Chimichurri
summaries.summary: Basil and Mint Chimichurri blends basil, mint, parsley, garlic, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, and olive oil into an Argentinean-style herb sauce.

summaries.name: Thai-Style Basil and Mint Stir-Fry
summaries.summary: Thai-Style Basil and Mint Stir-Fry is a stir-fry of chicken or tofu with Thai basil, mint, chilies, and lemongrass, served with steamed rice or noodles.

summaries.name: Basil and Mint Infused Water
summaries.summary: Basil and Mint Infused Water adds fresh basil and mint leaves to a pitcher of water for a refreshing infused drink.

summaries.name: Aphidius ervi
summaries.summary: Aphidius ervi is a species of parasitic wasp that preys on aphids and can be introduced to a garden to control aphid populations.

summaries.name: Azadirachta indica
summaries.summary: Azadirachta indica is the neem tree, from whose seeds neem oil is derived; the oil contains compounds that repel, inhibit the growth of, and can kill aphids.
